source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Βήρυλλος Επίσκοπος Κατάνης»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The page gives no year at all: it makes him a disciple of the Apostle Peter and says he died in deep old age, and a date written from the apostle's lifetime would be inferred rather than read, so there is no dates object. It says a service for him was written by Theophanes and by Joseph the Hymnographer, and does not say which Theophanes, so only Joseph is linked.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
